title: Two-turn tool loop over files the driver creates in the throwaway cwd

turns.prompt: List the files in the current directory, then read notes-alpha.txt and tell me the number written in it.
Now read notes-beta.txt and tell me the sum of that number and the previous one.

notes: The second turn forces the client to resend the first turn's tool_use / tool_result pair, which is the shape a single-turn case cannot produce.
